outcome: Proportion of technical vs. physiological alarms
cohort: 562 patients in a surgery and anesthesia unit
finding: The study found a high number of alarms (11.7 per patient), with the majority being technical, and a significant proportion going unacknowledged, highlighting the presence of alarm fatigue in the unit.
mod_finding: The most common operational procedure was caesarean section, but the study did not examine any outcomes related to mode of delivery.
